newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil steady in thin trade, buoyed by weathe.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil steady in thin trade, buoyed by weathe.

text.p: NWE gas oil was barely changed on Wednesday in a thin market trying to overcome public holidays that have made for a jerky trading week.
The U.K. was off on Monday and much of continental Europe will be on holiday on Thursday.
May IPE gas oil was trading 25 cents lower at $165.25 a tonne.
Heating oil barge premiums were a touch stronger around May IPE +75 cents, but interest was limited. Diesel barges were around May IPE +$10.50.
Cargoes were steady with June IPE $4-5 cif NWE talked for 0.2 pct while EN590s were pegged at June +$12-13 cif.

Traders said unseasonably cold weather in Europe and the eastern U.S. seaboard was underpinning the market, which some dealers had expected to be more frail following the closure of arbitrage opportunities to Asia.
